role.automated_source: ESPN public NFL team depth-chart endpoint

injury.automated_source: ESPN public NFL team injury endpoint

opponent.evidence_window: opponent prior completed 2026 regular-season games only

qb_context.automated_source: ESPN public NFL team depth-chart endpoint

safeguards: No sportsbook, odds, implied probability, spread, total or betting price may enter an adapter snapshot.
No arbitrary weekly mean or SD adjustment is generated before translation weights are separately calibrated.
Week 1 team-environment and opponent evidence may remain absent when no completed 2026 regular-season game exists.
Current injury status outranks depth-chart availability when the injury source explicitly indicates OUT, IR, PUP or suspension.
Every snapshot preserves source, capture time and raw evidence used for the classification.
